participant_a_prompt_text: Describe a time when you had to work with someone who was difficult to get along with. Explain how you managed to build a positive relationship with them, and ask your partner if they've ever had a similar experience.
participant_b_prompt_text: Your partner will tell you about a challenging person they've worked with. Discuss with them the strategies they used to build a positive relationship, and share any advice you might have based on your own experiences.
